About the Socialist Republic of Vostovia

History, geography, and the founding principles of the Republic

The Socialist Republic of Vostovia was proclaimed on 21 March 2024 following the unification of the toiling peoples of the Vostovian highlands under a single banner of socialist solidarity. Since its founding, the Republic has pursued a path of planned economic development, universal education, and collective ownership of the means of production.

Vostovia is a unitary socialist republic led by the Vostovian Socialist Workers' Party, in cooperation with the Supreme Soviet of the Toiling People and the Council of Ministers. The State guarantees to every citizen the right to work, free education, free medical care, and housing.

National Anthem"Arise, Vostovia!"
State Motto"Workers of Vostovia, Unite!"

A Brief History

Before 21 March 2024, the territory now comprising Vostovia was divided among several semi-autonomous highland provinces. Years of organising among workers' and peasants' councils across the tea-growing valleys and forested hills culminated in the Vostovian Revolution of 2024, after which the Congress of People's Deputies proclaimed the Socialist Republic in the newly designated capital of Novograd.

In the years since, the Republic has undertaken its First Five-Year Plan to build infrastructure, electrify rural communities, and expand free education and healthcare across its highlands and valleys. Under the guidance of the Council of Ministers and the Presidium, Vostovia continues to lay the foundations of a modern socialist state.

Home / Government

Structure of the Government

The organs of state power of the Socialist Republic of Vostovia

The government of Vostovia is organised according to the principle of democratic centralism, under the leadership of the Vostovian Socialist Workers' Party. State power is exercised through the following organs:

  • Vostovian Socialist Workers' PartyThe leading and guiding force of Vostovian society and the State, setting the general direction of national policy.
  • President of the RepublicHead of State and Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet; represents Vostovia both domestically and abroad.
  • Vice President of the RepublicAssists the President, oversees scientific and technological development, and heads the Ministry of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).
  • Council of MinistersThe highest executive and administrative organ of state power, responsible for implementing national policy and managing the ministries.
  • Supreme Soviet of the Toiling PeopleThe highest legislative organ of the Republic, elected by the citizens to enact laws and approve the state economic plan.
  • Supreme People's CourtThe highest judicial organ, safeguarding socialist legality and the rights of citizens.

Ministries of the Republic

Office of the Prime Minister

Led by Prime Minister Johirul Islam, coordinates the work of the Council of Ministers and assists in the day-to-day administration of the Republic.

Ministry of General Public Health Facility

Led by Minister Mahiruz, maintains general public health facilities and services for all citizens of the Republic.

Ministry of Culture and Art

Led by Minister MD. Abdullah bin Omar, promotes national culture, heritage, and the arts across the Republic.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs

Led by Minister Yan, conducts the diplomatic relations of Vostovia with fraternal and friendly nations.

Ministry of National Defence

Responsible for the defence of the Republic; the People's Armed Forces are commanded by Chief of the Military Dhruv Kennedy.

Ministry of Finance and State Planning

Oversees the state budget, taxation, and the Five-Year Plans.

Ministry of Industry and Heavy Engineering

Directs state enterprises in manufacturing, mining, and heavy industry.

Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reform

Administers collective farms and the distribution of agricultural produce.

Ministry of Education and Culture

Ensures free universal education and promotes the cultural development of the people.

Ministry of Public Health

Led by the Vice President, provides free and universal healthcare to all citizens of the Republic.

Ministry of Internal Affairs and Public Order

Led by Home Minister Zimam Zakaria, maintains civil order, public registries, and the People's Militia.

Ministry of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM)

Led by the Vice President, advances scientific research, technical education, and innovation across the Republic.

Ministry of Content Regulation

Led by Minister Samin Yasar Zarif, regulates and oversees media, publications, and digital content in accordance with the laws and values of the Republic.

Ministry of Sports and Events

Led by Minister Sudin Mondol, promotes physical culture and athletics, and organises national sporting events and public celebrations.

Ministry of Marine Resources and Water Development

Led by Minister Jasina Tahsin Zara, manages the Republic's marine resources, fisheries, and water infrastructure development.

Office of the President

Head of State of the Socialist Republic of Vostovia

Mashrur Hasan Shayan

President of the Socialist Republic of Vostovia
Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet

Comrade Mashrur Hasan Shayan was unanimously elected by the first Congress of the Supreme Soviet to serve as the founding President of the Socialist Republic of Vostovia following its proclamation in 2024. As Head of State, he represents the unity of the Vostovian people both at home and abroad.

The President presides over the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, promulgates the laws enacted by the Supreme Soviet, and works in close cooperation with the Council of Ministers to guide the nation's Five-Year Plans toward the prosperity of all working people.

Under his leadership, the Republic continues its dedication to collective welfare, industrial progress, universal education, and the fraternal solidarity of all socialist peoples.

Duties of the Presidency

  • Represents the Socialist Republic of Vostovia in international relations.
  • Presides over sessions of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet.
  • Promulgates the laws and decrees passed by the Supreme Soviet.
  • Serves as Supreme Commander of the People's Armed Forces.
  • Appoints and receives the credentials of diplomatic representatives.

Office of the Vice President

Vice President, Minister of STEM, and Minister of Public Health

Md. Ta-seen Imam Bhuiyan

Vice President of the Socialist Republic of Vostovia
Minister of STEM and Minister of Public Health

Comrade Md. Ta-seen Imam Bhuiyan serves as Vice President of the Socialist Republic of Vostovia and concurrently heads both the Ministry of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics and the Ministry of Public Health, guiding the Republic's efforts in scientific research, technical education, innovation, and universal healthcare.

He assists the President in the exercise of state duties and represents the Republic at scientific and technological forums at home and abroad, working to advance the Five-Year Plan's goals of modernisation and technical progress for all working people.

Workspace: Vostovia State Hospital

Duties of the Vice Presidency

  • Assists and, when necessary, deputises for the President of the Republic.
  • Directs the Ministry of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).
  • Promotes scientific research, technical education, and innovation across the provinces.
  • Directs the Ministry of Public Health and oversees free, universal healthcare for all citizens.

News & Announcements

Official statements from the organs of the State
28 September 2026

President Shayan Addresses the Supreme Soviet on the First Five-Year Plan

In a special session, President Mashrur Hasan Shayan outlined the goals of the Republic's First Five-Year Plan, emphasising rural electrification, highland infrastructure, and the expansion of public housing.

14 September 2026

Groundbreaking Ceremony for the New Novograd Hydroelectric Station

The Ministry of Industry and Heavy Engineering has broken ground on a new hydroelectric station that will supply power to three provinces upon completion.

01 September 2026

Highland Infrastructure Programme Expands to Novograd Valley

The Council of Ministers has approved new road and irrigation projects across the tea-growing valleys surrounding Novograd, part of the Republic's First Five-Year Plan.

19 August 2026

Ministry of Education Launches Nationwide Literacy Campaign

A new programme aims to achieve full literacy in all rural districts within three years, in cooperation with local People's Committees.
